page.overview:
Who is Eternity Devil?

The の|Eien no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of eternity. It is the titular main antagonist of the Eternity Devil arc and the Dating Denji arc.

The Eternity Devil's core is a lump of flesh in the shape of the number 8 which can also be seen as the infinity symbol with an eye and mouth on either side and two mouths in the center.

Within its own stomach the Eternity Devil can manifest as an endless wave of flesh consisting of many arms and heads fused together. It initially appears very small and weak but rapidly grows over time.

After its death, the Eternity Devil returned to Earth with a different appearance. When its effect is forcefully ended by Asa turning the aquarium into a spear, the Eternity Devil appears as a vaguely humanoid mass of partially melted fingers with a hood-like head with no facial features and instead of legs it has a slug-like foot. It appears to be far removed from the encompassing Devil it was before.
